externalReply.text: Jules, NookMarket gave you an unsupported promise that your money would be back today. That was wrong, and it should not be repeated as a bank guarantee. Rowan Finch owns the next steps and will update you by 15:45 UTC today. The evidence conflicts; no fraud determination has been made against either party.

A platform-funded no-fault resolution has been authorized on the terms you and Ada accepted: return $4,920 to your original card and pay Lumen its $4,520 net sale amount without charging you again or debiting Lumen for the refund. NookMarket will take the kit and packaging under those terms. Submission is conditional on complete-kit insured neutral custody; the 14:00–15:00 collection is booked, and custody has not happened yet. Please stop powering the body and retain all accessories and packaging. Only non-destructive handling is authorized.

If the complete custody receipt reaches Finance before 15:00 and its checks pass, Omar will submit in the 15:30 window and the team will confirm actual acceptance or failure by 15:45. If it arrives too late, the next window is tomorrow at 11:00; a material inventory or safety problem requires director review and a new update rather than a promise of automatic submission. Card posting normally takes five to ten business days after acceptance. The requested separate $120 rental contribution will also be submitted after its checks; it cannot be relied on as cash available for today’s rental.

This does not depend on a subscription purchase, criticism being removed or an admission by either party. Lumen will receive its own update, with payout timing described honestly. The order hold will be extended and verified while the approved instructions remain pending; unrelated shop service continues. The data explanation and correction of the earlier assurance remain open, and the team can share a minimized evidence summary without private account or other-user records.
